project_type: TypeScript MCP server (Playwright-MCP superset with a local Laya on-device decision engine). Runs over stdio; drives Playwright browsers and injects an on-page HUD overlay.
build_system: pnpm + tsc. Build via `pnpm run build` (tsc -p tsconfig.json emits dist/). Type-check only via `pnpm typecheck` (tsc --noEmit).
test_framework: vitest 3.x. Overlay behaviour is verified END-TO-END against REAL headless Chromium (test/overlay.test.ts, test/tier3-ux.test.ts): the overlay is FORCED ON (mode:'on') so it injects even headless, then assertions read the real DOM via page.evaluate/locators. Tests fail if injection/narration is reverted. No jsdom harness for the client script string.
test_command: pnpm test  (full suite). Overlay-focused: pnpm test test/overlay.test.ts test/tier3-ux.test.ts
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm install (already done). 2) pnpm exec playwright install chromium firefox (done; webkit host-deps unavailable in sandbox so webkit tests self-skip). 3) pnpm typecheck must pass. 4) pnpm test must be green. Baseline at session start: 244 passed / 2 skipped; the ONLY failure was test/cross-browser.test.ts because firefox was not yet installed - after `pnpm exec playwright install firefox` it passes (webkit case skips). Treat that as green baseline.
snapshot_or_generated_files: benchmark/RESULTS.md, benchmark/results.json and benchmark/charts/*.svg are generated by `pnpm run bench:compare`. They are NOT touched by this task; do not regenerate them.
setup_instructions: pnpm install; pnpm exec playwright install chromium firefox. Network is OPEN_INTERNET so downloads work. `pnpm exec playwright install-deps` fails (no apt-get) but is not needed for chromium/firefox headless which already run.
environment_constraints: Network: OPEN_INTERNET. The sandbox has NO display server, so a HEADED launch auto-falls-back to HEADLESS (see BrowserSession.launch in src/browser.ts). Therefore the headed-only visual behaviour (real OS window filling the viewport, cursor visibly moving in a visible window) CANNOT be eyeballed here. Verify via: the injected client-script string content, the real-headless overlay DOM assertions in test/overlay.test.ts + test/tier3-ux.test.ts, and tsc. webkit cannot launch (missing libx264 host lib); its cross-browser case self-skips.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. .github/workflows/ci.yml runs typecheck + test. Never break the overlay's core invariant: every overlay node is pointer-events:none with zIndex 2147483646 so it NEVER intercepts real clicks or changes automation semantics; every server-side overlay method is a guarded best-effort no-op that never throws into the caller. test/overlay.test.ts asserts this (pointer-events:none on every node, elementFromPoint at banner centre returns page not overlay, a real click still submits the form).
key_patterns: src/overlay.ts has TWO halves: (1) buildClientScript(optsJson) returns an IIFE STRING that runs IN the page, closes over nothing from Node, installs once via window.__layaOverlayInstalled, builds a fixed-position root (id __laya_overlay__, zIndex 2147483646), and exposes window.__layaOverlay with methods (setStatus/setState/progress/moveCursor/ripple/spotlight/toast/log/countdown/scrollIndicator/meter/...). (2) class BrowserOverlay drives those methods via page.evaluate, each wrapped in try/catch. To ADD an overlay feature you: add an element in build(), add a method on the in-page `api` object, add a matching async method on BrowserOverlay, and (if driven automatically) call it from src/autopilot/loop.ts's OverlayNarrator or from BrowserSession. OverlayClientOptions is JSON-embedded into the script; add serialisable fields there if the client needs new config. Colours: accent comes from OPTS.accent; several styles currently HARDCODE purple rgba (spotlight boxShadow rgba(168,85,247,0.25), ripple background rgba(168,85,247,0.5)) - these must be derived from the accent instead. config.ts DEFAULT_OVERLAY_ACCENT is the single default; browser.ts:189 has a duplicate hardcoded '#a855f7' in the disabled-overlay fallback.
